title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This handwritten page is written on the back of a typescript of SGA 7, Exposé IX (pp. 116–117, Barsotti–Tate groups and 'extensions panachées'). The handwriting is unrelated to that typescript. It belongs to the 1976 IHÉS lecture notes on the divided-power (pd) de Rham complex.

Setting. There is a functor k' ↦ S^{k'}. It sends a k-algebra k' to a graded algebra S^{k'} with divided powers. Its augmentation ideal (S^{k'})^+ carries divided powers compatible with the grading. There is also a chosen element (written f^{k'}, later t^{k'}) of degree δ.

Construction. Grothendieck forms the pd de Rham complex of the algebraic n-simplex over S^{k'}:
A_n(k') = S^{k'}{{X_0,…,X_n}}[dX_0,…,dX_n] / (ΣX_i − t, ΣdX_i)_pd.
This is Cartan's / Sullivan-type simplicial polynomial forms, but with divided-power polynomial algebras so that it works over any base. The simplex is 'homogenized': the relation ΣX_i = t replaces ΣX_i = 1, which makes it homogeneous.

Two gradings.
- One grading is induced from S^{k'} (the 'second degree'; the reading of the word naming it, possibly 'cohomologique', is uncertain).
- The other is a total degree, with deg X_r = deg dX_r = δ and scalars λ keeping their S^{k'}-degree.

The differential preserves total degree. So A_n(k') is a graded commutative dg-algebra (Δg) over S^{k'}, with divided powers compatible with both degrees. Everything is functorial in k' and in the simplicial index n, giving a simplicial graded pd-dga A^*(S, S^+, σ^*, t).

Use. By taking products, this structure passes to the cochain objects C^M_*(X; S, σ^*, t). Here X is presumably a simplicial set or space and M a coefficient datum. Taking the limit in k' recovers the structure on C_M(X; S^{k'}, σ^{k'}, t^{k'}). The aim is a strictly commutative pd-cochain model whose multiplicative structure is defined over a general base.

Step 9 (example). Take S = k[u] with its ordinary (additive) coalgebra structure. Then S^{k'} = Hom(S, k') = k'{{T}}, the completed divided-power series algebra; this is Cartier duality for the additive group. Take S̄ = k with S̄^{k'} = k'. The inclusion k → k[u] dualizes to the augmentation k'{{T}} → k'. Finally S^+ = k[u]/k ≅ k[u]^+.
errors: The rule 'deg tot X_r^{(n)} = δ' cannot hold if the divided powers are to be compatible with the total grading. γ_n of a degree-δ element must have degree nδ, so it should read deg X_r^{[n]} = nδ. Alternatively the superscript (n) is only the simplex index, in which case the line is redundant.

The relation as transcribed, ΣX_i − 1, is not homogeneous for total degree when δ ≠ 0. Since the page introduces an element of degree δ, the relation should be ΣX_i − t (or ΣX_i − f^{k'}); the '1' is likely a misreading or a slip.

ideas.what: Simplicial pd de Rham complex of the algebraic simplex, giving strictly commutative cochain algebras with divided powers over an arbitrary base
ideas.modern_name: Divided-power simplicial de Rham forms; Cartan's pd 'théories cohomologiques'; pd analogue of Sullivan's polynomial forms
ideas.usually_credited_to: H. Cartan (Théories cohomologiques, Invent. Math. 1976); Sullivan (rational case, 1977); later Miller and others on divided powers in cochains

ideas.what: Homogenized simplex ΣX_i = t with t of degree δ, giving a bigraded pd-dga with total degree deg X_r = δ
ideas.modern_name: Graded/weighted version of simplicial forms (Rees-type homogenization)

ideas.what: Dual of the additive coalgebra k[u] is the completed divided-power series algebra k'{{T}}, used as the coefficient pd-algebra
ideas.modern_name: Cartier duality between Sym and Γ (divided powers)

missed.claim: A homogenized, bigraded version of the simplicial pd de Rham complex with coefficients in a functor k' ↦ S^{k'} (e.g. k'{{T}}), apparently meant to give pd cochain models with an extra weight or 'parameter t' grading. It looks like a deformation/Rees construction of the pd cochain algebra over the divided-power line. This is not developed in published form, but it is close to known constructions.

missed.why_it_might_matter_today: A graded or filtered pd cochain model is of mild interest for integral and p-adic homotopy theory (e.g. comparison with derived de Rham and filtered models). It is probably subsumed by later work on pd/E∞ cochains.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a technical working page on a pd version of simplicial de Rham forms, close to Cartan 1976. The homogenized grading is a minor variation, and no apparently new result is stated.
transcription_corrections: '(ΣX_i − 1, ΣdX_i)' should probably be '(ΣX_i − t, ΣdX_i)' (or −f^{k'}), given the element of degree δ introduced just above.
'avec structure de Cartier[?] ordinaire' is very likely 'avec structure de cogèbre ordinaire' (coalgebra structure on k[u], whose dual is k'{{T}}).
'degré lexicien[?]' is uncertain; probably 'degré cohomologique' or another named degree 'déjà envisagé'.
'est un ⁿg.' at the top is likely 'est une Δg.' (anneau/dg-algèbre gradué), matching 'Δg. graduée' later.
'f^{k'}' is likely 't^{k'}', consistent with the later notation C(…, t^{k'}).
